task: Condition-level evidence matrix for NED editor acceptance cases 23.2.
source_spec: docs/tools/ned-editor/NED-editor仕様書.md#232-受入ケースと必要な証拠
case_id_policy: Uses the specification IDs NE-XC01 through NE-XC43; no parallel IDs are introduced.

status_policy.partial: At least one explicitly named condition has a passing test in the listed run, but the compound acceptance case is not fully demonstrated.
status_policy.unverified: No listed passing test directly measures that condition. Candidate test references, where present, are not treated as proof.

rust_focused.scope: All non-ignored lib unit tests matching tool::ned_editor.

node_ui_recovery_extensions.scope: UI, recovery, and extension unit/harness suites; composition is synthetic, not native IME.

rust_ignored_with_binary.scope: Three real-worker tests plus two loopback HTTP Viewer tests; explicitly gated tests only.

shutdown_signals.scope: Real child worker shutdown/reap for SIGINT and SIGTERM; SIGINT path stopped worker and observed KILL/reap.

browser_extensions.scope: One real Chromium flow; seven sanitized, hash-verified screenshots; CLI validate/run, UI run, partial result and Viewer were exercised.

isolated_restart_test.scope: Exact restored cancellation/manifest/response restart test, rerun alone.

isolated_existing_recovery_test.scope: Exact pre-existing state-recovery test, rerun alone.

shared_target_workspace_attempt.command: Parent full-workspace Cargo test in the same CARGO_TARGET_DIR while a second focused Cargo build was active.
shared_target_workspace_attempt.failure: Both failures were at run_control/tests.rs:31 opening current_exe because the test executable path ended in `(deleted)`. Parent confirmed concurrent same-target Cargo replacement. Both exact tests then passed in isolated invocations; no assertion or production code was changed to hide this failure.
shared_target_workspace_attempt.scope: Initial parent full-workspace attempt overlapped another Cargo build in the same target directory; retained as failed evidence. A later serial full-workspace run passed and is recorded separately.

serial_full_workspace_parent.scope: Initial serial full workspace before final controller fix; final rerun will be recorded separately.

saved_baseline_comparison.normalization: unchanged measure_can_million.py checker: full simulation, CSV run_id only; full metadata minus started_at_utc/finished_at_utc; RunReport output_path/manifest_path separately checked then removed with event_processing_wall_seconds

syntax_semantic_positions.scope: Separate BOM/CRLF/Unicode syntax EOF and unknown-type semantic errors: independently computed frozen source byte/line/column positions, PreparedFailed reply/no report/empty results/reaped worker; no simulate-call counter

browser_feasible_fixed.scope: Nine screenshots; same historical run through edit/Undo/Reload/New/create, current diagnostics preserved; real Viewer integrity failure, retry/no link, current diagnostic count0

run_completion_diagnostic_isolation.scope: 5 run commands x success/failure/panic; preserves controller+model diagnostics and job/ledger error/status, sequence/busy/recovery

serial_full_workspace_final.scope: Final registry/core/current-input diagnostic fixes and all test additions

rust_ignored_final.command: DIR_NED_RUN_TEST_BINARY=<fresh binary> CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<isolated target> cargo test --locked -p dir-simulator --lib tool::ned_editor::run_control -- --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1

ci_final_workspace_770c1e5.evidence_kind: GitHub job logs API; selected command, two unmodified timestamped success lines and lib summary; ANSI color removed from command
ci_final_workspace_770c1e5.scope: Final PR81 head CI workspace execution. Both named input::references tests occur in the unfiltered lib suite. This is separate from local serial_full_workspace_final and its original log/hash; no local rerun is claimed.

interpretation_boundaries: pinned_capacity_exact_boundary_and_one_byte_over_do_not_create_files mutates stored byte accounting; it proves admission arithmetic only, not physical disk quota or allocation failure.
running_plus_two_waiters_rejects_third_and_cancel_releases_one_slot sets a synthetic running phase; it proves slot accounting, not three live concurrent worker processes.
Run UI composition tests use a harness composition event, not native OS/browser IME input.
restart_after_durable_stop_classifies_manifest_and_response_independently persists fixture state and restarts the manager; it is not a process-kill test at every manifest/response cutpoint.
SIGINT/SIGTERM shutdown tests use real child processes and verify worker reap; they do not establish arbitrary editor-process kill/restart behavior at every journal boundary.
No physical ENOSPC, OOM, hardware quota, 1 GiB output, or full 43-case acceptance sweep is claimed.

assessment_errata.correction: Existing named test asserts prepare success; the old reason denying that measurement was incorrect.
Existing model tests include case-fold/kind refusal. New native HTTP/capture tests complement them; immutable snapshots do not probe newly changed disk paths during preview.
Existing tests already include100terminal resends and altered-payload409; new tests add held acceptance and actual HTTP response loss.
Existing raw TCP tests already exercise duplicateHost,Origin:null,CORS absence and revoke410.
Contract is4GiB address space,1GiB per file,2/10GiB soft logical totals; physical-RAM OOM/hardware quotas are not requirements.
Contract is one running worker plus two queued, and logical pin accounting independent of Undo, not three workers or physical quota.
